newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB up after Kleinwort recommendation.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB up after Kleinwort recommendation.

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting Plc rose for a second day on Tuesday as Dresdner Kleinwort Benson issued a "buy" recommendation in a 56-page research note on the stock, dealers said.
Analysts at Kleinwort were not immediately available for comment.

Separately BSkyB's broker BZW issued a "buy" recommendation on BSkyB shares on July 25, arguing that its strategy remained intact despite the departure of chief executive Sam Chisolm and deputy managing director David Chance, market sources said.
BZW analyst Vignesh Padiachy declined comment.
Continuing a rebound from recent losses, BSkyB shares were up 10-1/2p at 458-/2 by 1010 GMT in volume of 1.6 million shares.

News that BSkyB was increasing subscription rates to premium channels also helped lift the stock, dealers said. Satellite subscriptions will rise three stg to 29.99 per month for a package including movies and sport.

BSkyB shares tumbled from a level above 600p in mid June to set a 13-month low of 420p on July 10, unsettled by the departure of Chisolm and Chance and amid fears of growing regulatory and competitive threats.
Compounding those concerns, a press report earlier this month said Rupert Murdoch, chairman of 40 percent BSkyB shareholder News Corp, had described Sky shares as "grossly overpriced."
